DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家に知らない人の名前の封筒が届きました。住所は家と同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同住所の別人宛封筒が届いたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An envelope addressed to someone I don't know arrived at my home. The address is the same as mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that an envelope for someone else arrived at your address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。家族の名前でもないので、中は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封と家族宛でもないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. It isn't addressed to a family member either, so I haven't looked inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is unopened and isn't for your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達については郵便の窓口へ相談できます。何か心配な点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can consult the postal counter about delivery. Is there anything worrying you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ名前の封筒が三回届いたので、どう扱えばよいか分からず来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 繰返し届いた回数と困りごとを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Envelopes with the same name have arrived three times, so I came because I don't know what to do with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the number of repeated deliveries and your difficulty in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 宛名と届いた日を整理して、配達側へ伝えるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would help to organize the addressee's name and arrival dates and tell the delivery service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。中身を調べたり、知らない相手へ直接送ったりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容調査や本人への自己転送をしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't inspect the contents or send it directly to the stranger myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you won't examine the contents or forward it to the person yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒の表を見せられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you show me the front of the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらです。届いた日もメモしています。まず配達窓口へ扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒表と日付を示し配達窓口へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here it is. I've noted the arrival dates too. I'll first ask the delivery counter how it should be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the envelope front and dates and seek advice from the delivery counter in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表の情報と到着日をお持ちください。中を開けず、配達についての相談先へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring the information on the front and the arrival dates. Keep it unopened; I'll direct you to the appropriate delivery consultation service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 料金不足の通知が来ました。先週送った封筒の分か、控えと照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不足通知と発送控えの照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a notice of insufficient postage. I'd like to compare it with my sending record to see if it concerns the envelope I sent last week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to compare the postage-shortfall notice and sending record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知番号と差出し記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the notice number and mailing record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方あります。日付は近いですが、同じ封筒とはまだ確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知番号記録と対象未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both. The dates are close, but I haven't confirmed that they concern the same envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the notice number, record and unconfirmed item in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が番号と記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the number and record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。似た日に別の荷物も送ったので、金額だけで判断したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 複数発送があり金額だけで判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I sent another parcel around the same date, so I don't want to decide from the amount alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you sent multiple items and won't judge by the amount alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送った物の種類は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know what types of items you sent?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つは書類の封筒、もう一つは箱です。通知にどちらの情報があるか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒と箱を区別して対象情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: One was an envelope of documents and the other was a box. I'd like to see which one's information appears on the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the envelope and box and ask which item the information concerns in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで資料を並べて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's put the documents side by side and check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。対象が分かってから、不足分の支払い方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象確定後に不足分支払方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Once we know which item it concerns, I'll ask how to pay the shortfall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to pay the shortfall after identifying the item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知と二つの記録をお見せください。対象の発送を確認してから手続きを案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the notice and both records. We'll identify the mailing before explaining the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込のお手続きですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you making a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族の支払いを代わりにします。振込名を私の名前のままにしてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族分の代払で振込名義を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm paying on behalf of a family member. I don't know whether I can leave my own name as the transfer sender.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the transfer name when paying for a family member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払先から名前の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has the recipient specified a name to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号を付けると書いてありますが、誰の名前を入れるかは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号指定と名義の未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to add a number, but I haven't checked whose name to enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the specified number and unconfirmed sender name in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 支払先の照合方法を確かめる必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to check how the recipient matches payments.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、今は確定しません。家族の請求番号と必要な名義を支払先へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確定を保留し支払先へ照合条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't finalize it yet. I'll ask the recipient about my family member's invoice number and the required name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold off on confirmation and ask the recipient about matching requirements in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入力済みの内容はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金額と口座は入れました。名前と番号を確認してから、入力内容を全部見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入力済み箇所と全内容の再確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've entered the amount and account. After checking the name and number, I'll review all the entries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State which fields are filled and that you'll recheck all entries in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えは家族へ渡す予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you give the transfer record to your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。代わりに払ったことと、誰の請求分か分かるよう控えを共有します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 請求対象と代払が分かる控えを家族へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll share it so they can see that I paid on their behalf and whose bill it was for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll share a record identifying the billed person and payment on their behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 名義の指定を確認してからお進みください。入力は未確定のまま戻せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the name requirement before proceeding. You can go back without finalizing the entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗剤の表示についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the detergent label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の洗剤より濃いタイプを買いました。前のキャップ一杯で量ってよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濃縮品を旧キャップ一杯で量れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought a more concentrated type than before. I don't know whether I can measure it with one full old cap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can measure concentrated detergent with a full cap from the old product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の商品の使用量の欄を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at the dosage section for this product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この表示ですね。前と同じ一杯という言葉でも、キャップの大きさまで同じとは限りませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示量とキャップ容積を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This label, right? Even if both say one capful, the caps aren't necessarily the same size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the indicated dose from the cap's capacity in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 洗濯機の水量も関係します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The washing machine's water amount also matters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水量は機械の表示で確認します。服が多いから、と先に洗剤を倍に入れるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 機械水量を確認し衣類数だけで倍量にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the water amount on the machine's display. I won't put in double detergent first just because there are many clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll check the machine's water amount rather than double the dose based only on the clothes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回の容器には目盛りのあるキャップが付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This container comes with a marked measuring cap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では今回のキャップを使います。古い容器へ移す前に、新しい表示を残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回キャップを選び新表示を保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll use this product's cap. I'll keep the new label before transferring anything to the old container.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the current cap and retain the new label in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 詰替えの時も対応する容器を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: When refilling, also check that the container is suitable for that product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。水量と今回の表示で一回分を決め、別のキャップの一杯を代わりにしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水量新表示目盛りで一回分を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll decide the dose for one wash using the water amount and this label, not substitute a full different cap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Determine one dose using the water amount, new label and measuring marks in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この商品の用量表示をご確認ください。付属キャップの目盛りと合わせてお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check this product's dosage label and use it together with the markings on the supplied cap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遊ぶ場所のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a place to play?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが自転車の練習をしたいです。広い道なら、ここで練習してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園で子どもの自転車練習可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child wants to practise cycling. If the path is wide, can they practise here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether your child may practise cycling in the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 歩く方が多い道もあります。利用範囲を管理担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Some paths have many pedestrians. Let's ask park management about permitted areas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。広いからといって、どこでも練習してよいとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 道幅だけで利用可と考えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I don't assume practising is allowed everywhere just because it's wide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that path width alone doesn't establish permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 補助輪は付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does the bicycle have training wheels?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありません。まだふらつくので、人の横を無理に通らせたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 補助輪なしでふらつく状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. My child still wobbles, so I don't want them squeezing past people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that there are no training wheels and the child still wobbles.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日の人の多さも見て判断が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also need to consider how crowded it is today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。利用できる場所があっても、混んでいれば今日は歩く練習に変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混雑なら乗車練習を見送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Even if there is an allowed area, if it's crowded we'll switch to walking practice today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll postpone cycling practice if it's crowded.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保護者の方は付き添いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will a guardian accompany the child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が付き添います。場所と表示を確認してから、自転車に乗せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保護者付き添いと確認後の乗車を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll accompany them. I'll check the location and signs before letting them ride.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise in Japanese to accompany the child and check before letting them ride.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ利用範囲を確認します。それまでは自転車を押してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the permitted area with management. Until then, please wait with the bicycle, pushing it rather than riding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行情報をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the service information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日保存した画面では運休です。今日も同じだと思って来ましたが、表示が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の運休情報と今日の違いを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen I saved yesterday says services are suspended. I came assuming today was the same, but the display is different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the difference between yesterday's suspension information and today's.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面の日付をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the date on that screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の午後のものです。今日の更新時刻を見ずに、同じ状態だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存日付と更新未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's from yesterday afternoon. I assumed the same situation without checking today's update time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the saved date and that you hadn't checked updates in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の行き先と列車を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check today's destination and train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。運転再開という表示だけで、全ての列車が予定どおりとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再開表示だけで全列車正常と考えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I won't assume every train is running to schedule just because it says services resumed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a resumption notice alone doesn't mean all trains are on time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待ち合わせの予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have plans to meet anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。今の案内で乗れる列車が決まってから、相手へ時間を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乗れる列車決定後に約束相手へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll tell them the time after deciding which train I can take using current information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll contact the person after identifying an available train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい表示の更新時刻も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the update time on the new display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日の表示を保存し、昨日の画像は今日の案内として使わないよう分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の更新を保存し旧画像と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll save today's display and keep yesterday's image separate so I don't use it as today's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Save today's update and separate the old image in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在の案内はこちらです。出発前にも更新をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the current information. Please check for updates again before departure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雪についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の前の道に雪が残っています。市へ頼める道なのか、自分たちで管理する道なのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅前雪道の管理区分を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Snow remains on the road in front of my home. I don't know whether we can ask the city or whether we manage the road ourselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese who manages the snowy road in front of your home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you point out the location on a map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。大きい道路から家へ入る短い道です。公道とはまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図で小道を示し公道未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. It's a short road leading from the main road to my home. I haven't confirmed it's a public road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the small road on a map and explain that its public-road status is unconfirmed in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道の管理区分を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about who manages it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。近所の人に市が必ず来ると言われましたが、約束されたとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 近隣の話を市の約束と扱わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. A neighbour said the city would definitely come, but I don't consider that a promise from the city.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a neighbour's statement isn't a promise from the city.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩けますが、車は出しにくいです。道の端に置かれた雪も一緒に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 歩行可能だが車が出しにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: We can walk, but it's difficult to get the car out. I'd also like advice about the snow piled at the edge of the road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that walking is possible but getting the car out is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の様子が分かる写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have a photo showing the current condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今朝の写真です。場所と通行状態を伝え、対応できる範囲を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日写真で状態と対応範囲を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: This morning's photo. I'll explain the location and access conditions and ask what can be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use today's photo to discuss conditions and the scope of assistance in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 地図と写真を担当へお見せください。管理区分と相談先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the map and photo to the person in charge. We'll check who manages it and where to seek advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どこを痛められましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の手首です。朝に滑って転び、その時はあまり痛くありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転倒と右手首痛を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My right wrist. I slipped and fell in the morning, but it didn't hurt much then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the fall and right-wrist pain in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 痛みが強くなったのはいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did the pain get worse?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜になってからです。転んだ時刻と、痛みが気になった時刻は違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転倒時刻と疼痛増加時刻を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: After it got to evening. The time of the fall and when the pain started bothering me are different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the fall time from the time pain increased in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 転んだ時に手をつきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you put your hand down when you fell?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右手をつきました。腫れがあるかは自分で判断しにくいので、見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右手をつき腫れ判断を診察へ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I landed on my right hand. I find it difficult to judge whether there's swelling, so I'd like you to examine it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you landed on your right hand and ask for swelling to be assessed in the examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今、動かすとどうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: How is it when you move it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 物を持つと痛いです。動かせるから大丈夫と決めて仕事へ戻るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 物を持つ痛みと自己判断復帰を避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It hurts when I hold things. I don't want to return to work simply deciding it's fine because I can move it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain pain when holding things and your wish to avoid deciding on your own to return to work in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持病や飲んでいる薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have ongoing medical conditions or take any medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この手帳にあります。転倒の経過と薬を示して、診察で作業に戻る相談もします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬手帳と経過を提示して復帰相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: They're listed in this booklet. I'll show my medicines and what happened in the fall and discuss returning to tasks during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your medication booklet and the sequence of events and ask about returning to work in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 経過を記録します。手帳を持って診察をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll record what happened. Please wait for your examination with the booklet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駐車についてでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近くの駐車場の表示が雪で隠れています。空いている所へ置いてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雪で隠れた駐車表示と利用可否を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Snow is covering the signs at a nearby car park. I don't know whether we can park in an empty space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about snow-covered parking signs and whether parking is allowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今はそこへ駐車されていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。同行者が車を安全な場所で待たせています。空きだけで使えるとは決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未駐車で安全待機中と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. My companion is waiting with the car somewhere safe. I haven't assumed an empty space means it's available to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you haven't parked and are waiting safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所と表示を管理者へ確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The location and signs need to be checked with the manager.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では駐車場の入口にある連絡先へ聞きます。雪を勝手に動かして区画を作ることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 管理者へ確認し自己除雪で区画を作らないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll ask using the contact details at the car park entrance. I won't move snow myself to create a space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll check with the manager rather than clear snow to make a space yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通行の妨げになっている所はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待機場所は通路を空けています。ただ、長く待たせず別の利用先も探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路を空け代替場所も探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Where we're waiting leaves the passage clear. But I'll look for another place too rather than have them wait a long time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the passage is clear and you'll also seek an alternative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真で入口が分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you show the entrance in a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらです。管理者へ場所を示して、利用できる区画を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口写真で管理者へ区画確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here. I'll show the location to the manager and ask which spaces can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use an entrance photo to ask the manager about parking spaces in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 管理者の案内を確認してください。一般の道路を駐車場の空き区画と取り違えないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow the manager's information. Don't mistake a public road for an empty parking space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。来る途中で雪に濡れ、宛名の番地がにじんでしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛名番地が雪でにじんだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Snow wet it on the way here, and the street-number part of the address has blurred.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that snow blurred the street number in the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の中身まで濡れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has the inside of the envelope got wet too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中身は袋に入れてあるので、今見える範囲では乾いています。宛名は書き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中身の状態と宛名修正希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The contents are in a bag, and as far as I can currently see they're dry. I'd like to rewrite the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the contents' condition and wish to correct the address in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい封筒も使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use a new envelope too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では入れ替えます。にじんだ数字を上からなぞって、別の番地に見えるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: なぞり修正でなく新封筒へ入替を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll transfer the contents. I want to avoid tracing the blurred numbers and making them look like a different street number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a new envelope rather than tracing over the blurred address in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 正しい住所が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have something showing the correct address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯に相手からの住所があります。そこからもう一度確認して書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手からの正しい住所を再照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the address the recipient sent on my phone. I'll check it again there before writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Recheck the correct address provided by the recipient in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人の住所も書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write the sender's address too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。宛先と差出人を両方書き、新しい封筒で送る前に読みやすさを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先差出人を明瞭に書き発送前確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll write both recipient and sender details and check legibility before sending the new envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll write both addresses clearly and check before mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい封筒をご用意ください。書き直してから料金と差出し方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please prepare a new envelope. After rewriting it, we'll check the postage and sending method.
